market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $115 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$100-102 on May 6, off May 1 high of ~$106 on Iran deal news. $115 requires ~15% rally in ~25 days. EIA Brent Q2 peak target is $115 (WTI $3-5 lower). Plausible only on Hormuz re-escalation.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Iran-Israel ceasefire stability; Hormuz transit risks.
